# AIProdGen

> AIProdGen is an AI product photography, lifestyle staging, and e-commerce marketing campaign studio. Upload one raw phone snapshot of a product to generate Amazon-ready white-background photos, photorealistic lifestyle scenes, and conversion-focused product copy—with lifetime software access and zero markup on AI compute (Bring Your Own Google Gemini API Key).

Last updated: 2026-11-19

## Core Capabilities
- **Commercial Product Photography**: Pure white RGB (255, 255, 255) backgrounds, studio softbox lighting, and physically grounded contact shadows formatted for Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, and Google Shopping.
- **Creative Lifestyle Staging**: Photorealistic architectural, outdoor, and luxury scenes in 1:1 (feed), 9:16 (Reels/TikTok), and 16:9 (hero banners).
- **Conversion Marketing Copy & Blueprints**: AI-generated Amazon titles, 5-bullet feature lists, Shopify SEO descriptions, and PAS ad hooks.
- **4K Ultra-HD Upscaling**: Platform credit-based upscaling for high-DPI print and hero catalog visuals.

## Pricing & Business Model (Lifetime + BYOK)
AIProdGen charges a one-time software license instead of recurring monthly SaaS fees. Users connect their own Google Gemini API key (AES-256-GCM encrypted in their account vault) and pay Google directly at wholesale API rates (~$0.039 per image) with 0% platform markup.

- **Free Explorer**: $0 forever — 20 BYOK generations/month, personal evaluation use (watermarked).
- **Hobbyist Lifetime**: $47 one-time (or ₹3,999 INR) — 500 BYOK generations/month, no watermarks, full commercial store rights.
- **Pro Founder Lifetime**: $97 one-time — 3,000 BYOK generations/month, 50 starter 4K upscale credits, Campaign Blueprint & Production Engine, Director Studio + Veo integration.
- **Agency Lifetime**: $197 one-time — 25,000 BYOK generations/month, 120 starter 4K upscale credits, bulk mode, commercial client-deliverable rights.
